Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shams Uz Zaman,Praveen Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking the quashing of order dated 17-10-2022
whereby non-bailable warrant has been issued by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffarnagar in
Case Crime No. 46 of 2002, under Sections 498A, 304B, 342, 201, 506 Ipc, P.S. Charthawal,
District Muzaffarnagar.
Heard counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA and perused the record.

The submission made by the learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is a 'Chachiya Sasur' and is facing a case no. 1290 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B, 342, 201, 506 IPC, P.S.
Charthawal, District Muzaffarnagar.

Since the matter is pending since 2002 before the Court in 482 Application No. 3461 of 2002 and on 30-11-2022 the proceedings were stayed by applying the principles of Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Pvt. Ltd. and other Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation decided on 28.03.2018.
However, a request has been made that the accused wants to surrender in the court below and apply Shamimuddin vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195355803/

With the aforesaid observations, this application is finally disposed of Order Date :- 20.3.2023/
